context.person: A person using a collaborative health journal

current_content.body: Review the latest information and continue.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product banner so the person can understand data export includes shared records, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Review and exclude shared comments before export.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The downloaded file may expose another person's information.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Review the included records and choose the appropriate scope before downloading.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
